label: sec:garside-gram-intro
html: The derived-atom examples in §5 produce specific normal forms but leave the Frobenius Gram weighting implicit. We define the typed Garside element of the nuclear braid to organize the typed crossings in staircase form. We establish the \mathcal{Q}_q-value as the G^{-1}-weighted Frobenius norm over conversion channels (convention D: G is singular on H_n, so the weighting is taken on the non-degenerate quotient H_n/\mathrm{rad} \cong \mathrm{TL}_n — see MarkovGramDegenerate.lean). This norm supplies the input for the transfer-matrix calculations in §7. We then show that the Gram eigenstructure is the adjoint character on Wedderburn blocks. This anchors the \mathcal{Q}_q-value in the Jucys--Murphy spectral data.
